mapper.select: /* SQL ID: com.winter.winter_back.domain.store_old.dao.StoreDao.getCategories SQL 명: 카테고리 조회 */ SELECT category_id, category_code, category_name FROM tb_category WHERE use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY category_name

/* SQL ID: com.winter.winter_back.domain.store_old.dao.StoreDao.getStoresByCategory SQL 명: 카테고리별 상점 조회 */ SELECT s.idx, s.store_name, s.latitude, s.longitude, s.average_rating, c.category_name FROM tb_store s INNER JOIN tb_store_category_map scm ON s.idx = scm.store_id INNER JOIN tb_category c ON scm.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY s.average_rating DESC

/* SQL ID: com.winter.winter_back.domain.store_old.dao.StoreDao.getMenusByStore SQL 명: 상점별 메뉴 조회 */ SELECT menu_id, store_id, menu_name, price, best_yn FROM tb_menu WHERE store_id = #{storeId} ORDER BY best_yn DESC, price ASC
